clips.title: Add a loom
clips.description: Create Demo Loom 01 and select its machine type, Rapier.

clips.title: Add a piece-rate operator
clips.description: Create Demo Operator 01 as a piece-rate weaver and approved loom operator, available for the day shift.

clips.title: Activate a costing and prepare yarn stock
clips.description: Choose saved costing v2 for the demo fabric. Add 200 kg each of the required warp and weft yarns, then activate the quality for production.

clips.title: Assign the quality to a loom
clips.description: Assign the demo quality to Demo Loom 01, then find the loom on the machine board.

clips.title: Assign the day-shift operator
clips.description: Open Manage Workers, select Day Shift, find Demo Operator 01, and assign the operator to the loom.

clips.title: Record and save daily production
clips.description: Enter 240 metres for the demo loom. Review worker totals and earnings, then save the shift. Other machines remain pending so their readings can be entered later.

clips.title: Review the saved receipt and earnings
clips.description: Open the permanent production audit receipt and worker review. The demo operator produced 240 metres at the saved Rs 16/m rate, earning Rs 3,840.
